claims: The men’s NCAA tournament field expanded to 64 teams in 1985.
Only two No. 16 seeds have defeated a No. 1 seed in the men’s NCAA tournament since the field expanded to 64 teams in 1985.
No. 16 UMBC Retrievers defeated No. 1 Virginia Cavaliers 74-54 in 2018.
No. 16 Fairleigh Dickinson Knights defeated No. 1 Purdue Boilermakers 63-58 in 2023.
Before 2018, No. 1 seeds were 135-0 against No. 16 seeds.
UMBC became the first 16-seed to defeat a No. 1 seed in 2018.
Fairleigh Dickinson was the smallest team in the 2023 men’s NCAA tournament.
A 16-seed has won only two times in 150+ matchups against No. 1 seeds.
